test_title: PYST 17: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I - Reasoning (Held On: 12 Jun, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
Based on the English alphabetical order, three of the following four letter-clusters are alike in a certain way and thus form a group. Which letter-cluster DOES NOT belong to that group?

(Note: The odd one out is not based on the number of consonants/vowels or their position in the letter-cluster.)
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4a5b7cf84abd4e09a63d504f404b2035f579e6a3a005e11d54e3ca50bd42a099.png] 

The logic followed here is:​

Option 1) MTO

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c517da6be4e76ef94dfb0a638a1cf7b59f9eae99861248572c8c6576d9edd125.png] 

Option 2) JQL

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c632c5d6043fc438c97b772621c3cfa531373112560754bf0ab19c892d60b04f.png] 

Option 3) PWR

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7fc600fa6a9ef8d7e09db07367a4335417619537222062f7ee5f655a06f9b40f.png] 

Option 4) GNJ

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a410de468715e9404a22e9ee497b36474ed3b5859380d18f70624da893c34e0b.png] 

Thus, out of all the options, 'GNJ' is the odd one out.

Hence, "Option 4" is the correct answer.
